description: This Java source file defines the `IncomingRequestWearService` class, which extends `WearableListenerService`. It handles incoming messages from a paired mobile device in a wearable Android app context. The class processes data messages to request permissions or sensor data, responds with permission prompts or sensor information, and manages communication via Google Play Services APIs. It also initiates activities to prompt user permissions when needed.

classes.name: IncomingRequestWearService
classes.description: A service class that listens for incoming messages from a paired phone device, handles permission requests, and responds with sensor information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and logs creation.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming message events, determines the message type, and triggers appropriate responses.

methods.name: promptUserForSensorPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests user permission for sensor access; prompts user via an activity if permission is not granted.

methods.name: respondWithSensorInformation
methods.description: Responds with the number of sensors on the device if permission is granted, or requests permission if not.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the connected device using GoogleApiClient, handling capability detection and message transmission.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the best node (preferably nearby) from a set of connected nodes to send the message.
